# Employment Incentives

> A comprehensive resource for disability employment, tax incentives, assistive technology, and hiring qualified candidates with disabilities.

Employment Incentives provides information on federal and state employment programs, tax benefits, and assistive technology solutions to support workers with disabilities and employers seeking to hire them. The organization, based in Philadelphia, PA, partners with RecruitDisability and other organizations to promote workforce diversity and inclusive hiring practices.

## Key Topics

- Disability Employment
- Employment Incentives Programs
- Affordable Care Act (ACA)
- Tax Benefits
- Job Board
- Assistive Technology
- Special Needs Trusts
- Disability Hiring
- Vocational Rehabilitation
- Workforce Diversity
- Federal-State Programs
- Case Settlements
- ACA Impact
- Web Accessibility
- Disability Recruitment
